headline: No votes on projects; discussed a street light LED upgrade that is still awaiting a GIS lighting map, and approved June 8 meeting minutes.
summary: Members approved the June 8 minutes. Town engineer Stephen White is still working on a GIS map for a street light plan.

decision_evidence.quote: PJ Deak made a motion to approve June 8th's meeting minutes. David Cooper seconded the motion. Motion was approved.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Energy Use & Climate Change 
Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, August 10, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1 CALL TO ORDER   
 Commission Chair Brendan Smith called the meeting to order at 7:05pm. 
2 ATTENDANCE   
 Brendan Smith, Henry Dinia, David Cooper, Alison DeMaio, and PJ Deak. 
3 APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 PJ Deak made a motion to approve June 8th's meeting minutes. David Cooper seconded 
the motion. Motion was approved. 
4 PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comment recieved. 
5 CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 No correspondence received. 
6 EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 No executive session needed 
7 REPORTS   
 No reports reviewed. 
8 OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
   a. Street Light LED Upgrade 
 
   
  Brendan discussed his follow up with town engineer Stephen White:
• No updates were received. 
• Stephen White is still working on GIS map for a lighting plan based on records 
from UI's proposed replacements. 
o Once GIS map is completed, they can make a lighting plan, look at the 
coverage, and then make edits. 
 
   b. Simplify Solar/SolarAPP+ 
   
  Brendan reviewed his discussion with Carlos Sarmiento from the town building office 
about the app. 
Discussion was had regarding removing this item from the agenda as it has been 
completed. 
David Cooper asked about additional generation for potential AI usage in the town 
and the commission having a bigger role in project advice and/or approval. 
• Topic will be revisited towards the beginning of 2027. 
  
   c. September EUCC Public Comment Session?  
  
 
   d. PA 26-127 - Sec 9 “portable solar generation device”:  
https://cga.ct.gov/2026/ACT/PA/PDF/2026PA-00127-R00HB-05340-PA.PDF  
  Brendan discussed how the Outreach and Enforcement advises people not to install 
these portable solar devices until the bill is finalized. 
9 NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
   a. Any New Commissioner Applications/Approvals?  
  No new applications received. 
Discussion: 
• Removal of inactive Commissioners 
• Advertise Commission 
• Renewing Commissioner membership 
•   
 
   b. Discuss EUCC agenda decision making framework: 
 
   
  
 
   i. Is an item we can vote on  
  
 
 
 
ii. Can we make a recommendation
iii. Are we asking for approval/adoption by another Hamden Gov Entity 
       
  
 
 
 
iv. What information do we need to understand to map out the path to the goal 
       
  
 
   c. Summaries of other Board and Commission meetings  
  No summaries discussed. 
   d. Solar and Fuel Cells on Town Property with “ACES UP”  
  Brendan reviewed a letter from the Legislative Council and discussed the 
commission's involvement. 
  
   e. Sustainable CT Project Categories: 
 
   
  
 
   i.    Tree Planting Program  
  
 
   ii.    Cool roof installation on a municipal or BOE building 
 
 
   
  
 
   iv.    Purchase an electric vehicle or electric bus for municipal use 
   
  
 
   v.    EV Charger purchase and/or installation 
   
  
 
   vi.    Energy benchmarking or energy planning 
   
  
 
   vii.    Energy efficiency projects in municipal or BOE buildings 
   
  
 
   viii.    Renewable energy or battery storage system installation in municipal/BOE 
buildings or properties 
   
  
 
   ix.    Municipal or BOE energy audit and/or implementation of municipal or BOE 
building energy audit recommendations
xi.    Other (please describe the climate mitigation benefit of your project. Projects not 
included on our list will be approved on a case-by-case basis.)  
  
 
10 ADJOURNMENT   
 PJ Deak made a motion to adjourn the meeting. Alison DeMaio seconded. Meeting 
adjourned at 8:02PM.
